Name: Crab Pot Bait Bubbles
Author: iodine131131
Description:
Code written by AI.
Shows bait bubbles above crab pots indicating that they don't have bait inside. Doesn't show bubbles if player has Mariner profession.

GMCM Support for hotkey customization (default key - Left Alt) and mode.

3 modes:
Always - always shows bait bubbles above empty crab pots.
Hold Key - shows bait bubbles above empty crab pots when hotkey is held (default key - Left Alt).
Off -  never shows bait bubbles above empty crab pots.

Probably uses some code from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/17761]Crop harvest Bubbles[/url] and/or [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/17773]Crop Watering Bubbles[/url], I don't remember tbh.
